function getBookIdFull(url) {
	const {java} = this
	$ = JSON.parse(url).data
	if ($.book_shelf_info != 0 && $.book_shelf_info != undefined) {
		arr = $.book_shelf_info.map($ => $.book_id)

getShelf = () => {
let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'
let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
  headers: {
    'Cookie': ck
  }
}))

bid = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
let id_list = splitArray(bid, 100)
let urls = []
id_list.forEach(i => {
    urls.push(source.bookSourceUrl + "/multi-detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
})

res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

let resp = {book_info: []}
res.forEach(r => {
  resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
})

return resp
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
  let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'

  let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
      'Cookie': ck,
    }
  })))
  let group_bookids = {
    "未分组": []
  }
  // java.log(
  book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
    if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
    group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
  })
  // java.log(JSON.stringify(group_bookids["未分组"]))
  // java.log(decodeURIComponent(name))
  if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return {data: []}
  //java.log("awa")
  let book_ids = splitArray(group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)], 100)
  let urls = []

  book_ids.forEach(i => {
    urls.push(source.bookSourceUrl + "/multi-detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
  })
  
  res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

  let resp = {book_info: []}
  res.forEach(r => {
    resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
  })

  return resp
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
  let url = _mlsec.requestHeader(
	  "bookmall/tab",
    "version_name=5.8.9.32",
	  null,
	  ck
  )
  let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
  let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index].cell_data
  if (!tab) tab = []
  let bookList = []
  for (let i of tab) {
    bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    // java.log(JSON.stringify(i.book_data))
  }
  return { book_info: bookList }
}

if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
else {
  let w = baseUrl.split("/")
  if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
    result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
  } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
    result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
  } else result = JSON.parse(result)
}
JSON.stringify({data: result.book_info || result.data.book_info || result.detail_list || result.data})
</js>

<js>
  let defaultVariable = {
    "volume": {
      "status": false,
      "mode": 1,
      "spacer": " | ",
      "emptyVolumeName": {
        "action": false,
        "replace": "第一卷：默认"
      },
      "onlyOneShow": false
    }
  }
  let variable = (book.getVariable("custom") != "" && book.getVariable("custom") != null) ? book.getVariable("custom") : source.getVariable();
  if(variable != "" && variable != null){
    try{
      variable = JSON.parse(variable);
    } catch(err) {
      java.log(err);
      variable = defaultVariable;
    }
  } else {
    variable = defaultVariable;
  }
  let data = JSON.parse(result).data;
  let list = data.chapterListWithVolume;
  let volume = data.volumeNameList;
  let chapters = [];
  let volume_names = [];
  for(let i in list){
    for(let x in list[i]){
      let c = list[i][x];
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 1 && volume_names.indexOf(c.volume_name) == -1){
        volume_names.push(c.volume_name);
        if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          chapters.push({
            title: ((c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace) ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name),
            isVolume: true
          });
        }
      }
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 2){
        if(c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace){
          c.title = (c.volume_name == "" ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name) + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        } else if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          c.title = c.volume_name + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        }
      }
      c.url  = `https://fanqienovel.com/reader/${c.itemId}?enter_from=page&force_mobile=0`;
      chapters.push(c);
    }
  }
  chapters
</js>

ruleContent.replaceRegex:
<js>
// 全局清理包含“苦读书”名称及网址的广告文本
result = result.replace(/\n?\(?苦读书\s+(www\.)?kudushu\.org\)?\s?/g, "");

// 转义标题变量中的特殊字符，确保正则安全
let safeTitle = title.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

// 根据标题长度动态匹配并清理正文中的重复标题行
if (title.length < 5) {
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${safeTitle}\\s*\\n`, "i"), "");
} else {
    let shortTitle = safeTitle.substr(0, Math.floor(safeTitle.length * 2 / 3));
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${shortTitle}.*\\n`, "i"), "");
}

// 匹配并移除以“第X章”开头的特征行，防止章节名残留
result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*第\\S+?章.{0,${title.length}}\\n`, "i"), "");

// 清理文末各种括号格式的“本章完”字样
result = result.replace(/\s*[（|(]本章完[)|）]\s*/g, "");

result;
</js>

<js>
let pages = Array.from(java.getStringList('option@value', null, true));

var chapters = java.ajaxAll(pages).flatMap(m => {
    let chapterLists = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(m.body()).select('.section-list');
    return Array.from(chapterLists.get(1).select('a'));
});

var list = chapters.map((item, i) => {
    let url = String(item.attr('href'));
    if (!url) {
        let thUrl = i < chapters.length - 1 ? chapters[i+1].attr('href') : chapters[i-1].attr('href');
        let ruleStr = i < chapters.length - 1 ? "#prev_url@href" : "#next_url@href";
       if (String(thUrl)) url = "data:;base64," + java.base64Encode(ruleStr + "|" + thUrl) + ',{"type": "chapter"}';
    }
    //java.log(url)
    return { 
        name: item.text(), 
        Url: url
    };
});
list;
</js>

(function(){
    function needVerify(s){
        s = String(s || '');
        return /Just a moment|Cloudflare|challenge-platform|cf-browser-verification|security check|验证您是真人/i.test(s);
    }
    function trim(s){
        return s ? String(s).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') : '';
    }
    function text(doc, sel){
        var e = doc.select(sel).first();
        return e ? trim(e.text()) : '';
    }
    function attr(doc, sel, name){
        var e = doc.select(sel).first();
        return e ? trim(e.attr('abs:' + name)) : '';
    }

    var html = String(result || '');
    if (needVerify(html)) {
        try { cookie.removeCookie(source.getKey()); } catch(e) {}
        html = java.startBrowserAwait(baseUrl, 'CF验证').body();
    }

    var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html, baseUrl);
    var introNode = doc.select('#book_info .intro').first();
    var intro = '';
    if (introNode) {
        introNode.select('a').unwrap();
        intro = trim(introNode.text());
    }

    var kind = text(doc, '.title99.title a[href*=book/index.php?type]');
    var tags = [];
    var tagEls = doc.select('#book_info h4:eq(1) a');
    for (var i = 0; i < tagEls.size(); i++) {
        var t = trim(tagEls.get(i).text());
        if (t && t != kind) tags.push(t);
    }
    if (tags.length > 0) {
        kind = kind ? (kind + ',' + tags.join(',')) : tags.join(',');
    }

    var count = doc.select('#dir dd').size();
    return {
        n: text(doc, '#book_info h2'),
        a: text(doc, '#author_box h4') || text(doc, '#book_info h4:eq(0) a'),
        k: kind,
        w: count > 0 ? (count + '章') : '',
        l: text(doc, '#dir dd:last-child a'),
        i: intro,
        c: attr(doc, '#book_info img', 'src'),
        t: String(baseUrl)
    };
})()
</js>

ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
(function(){
    function needVerify(s){
        s = String(s || '');
        return /Just a moment|Cloudflare|challenge-platform|cf-browser-verification|security check|验证您是真人/i.test(s);
    }
    function trim(s){
        return s ? String(s).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') : '';
    }
    function parse(html){
        var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(html || ''), baseUrl);
        var items = doc.select('ul.list_box > li');
        var arr = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < items.size(); i++) {
            var it = items.get(i);
            var author = '';
            var kind = '';
            var h4s = it.select('h4');
            for (var j = 0; j < h4s.size(); j++) {
                var t = trim(h4s.get(j).text());
                if (!author && /作者[:：]/.test(t)) author = t.replace(/^.*?作者[:：]\s*/, '');
                if (!kind && /分类[:：]/.test(t)) kind = t.replace(/^.*?分类[:：]\s*/, '');
            }
            arr.push({
                n: trim(it.select('h2>a').text()),
                a: author || trim(it.select('h4:contains(作者) a').text()),
                k: kind || trim(it.select('h4:contains(分类) a').text()),
                i: trim(it.select('.intro').text()),
                c: trim(it.select('img').attr('abs:src')),
                u: trim(it.select('h2>a').attr('abs:href'))
            });
        }
        return arr;
    }

    var html = String(result || '');
    var list = parse(html);

    if (list.length == 0 && needVerify(html)) {
        html = java.startBrowserAwait(baseUrl, 'CF验证').body();
        list = parse(html);
    }

    return list;
})()
</js>

let limit = Number(baseUrl.match(/limit=(\d+)/)[1]);


let commentTotal  =  Number(java.getString("$.data.commentTotal"));

let page = Math.ceil(commentTotal/limit);

function getPlainText(cl) {
    let output = "";
    let cllen = cl.length;
    let sss = String(source.getVariable());
    let re = /^([\[\]橘糖紫糖]|嗑到了|kswl|\[.*?\]|\d+\.\d+\.\d+|.刷|打卡|\s)+$|为营造更好的评论环境，/;
    let sre = sss.match(/屏蔽【(.*?)】/)?.[1] ?? null;
    sre = sre ? new RegExp(sre.replace(/,/g, '|'), 'g') : null;    
    let plen = 0;
    let validCount = 0;

    for (let i in cl) {
        let c = cl[i];
        let reply = (c?.replyAll ?? c?.reply);
        let rl = [];

        // 跳过屏蔽内容
        if (re.test(c.commentBody ?? c.commentbody) || (sre ? sre.test(c.commentBody ?? c.commentbody) : null)) {
            cllen--;
            plen++;
            continue;
        }

        // 处理回复
        for (let j in reply) {
            let r = reply[j];
            if (re.test(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody) || (sre ? sre.test(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody) : null)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            let authorTag = r?.isAuthor === "1" ? "👑" : "📜";
            
            rl.push({
                text: `${authorTag} ${r.replyAuthor ?? r.commentauthor} (${(!r.comment_date_time ? undefined : java.timeFormat(r.comment_date_time *1000)) ?? (r.replyDate || r.commentdate)})\n ${replaceEmoticons(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody)}`
            });
        }
        // 构建主评论
        let authorTag = "";
        if (c?.isAuthor === "1") {
            authorTag = "👑";
        } else if (c?.bulletinComment === "1") {
            authorTag = "📢";
        } else {
            authorTag = "👤";
        }

        // 主评论头部信息（作者、时间、订阅、互动数据）
        
        
        let header = `${authorTag} ${c.commentAuthor ?? c.commentauthor} `;
        let time = ` 📆${(!c.comment_date_time ? undefined : java.timeFormat(c.comment_date_time * 1000)) ?? (c.commentDate || c.commentdate || '')}`
        // 订阅信息
        
        if (c.subscriptionicon) {

        }

        // 互动数据
        header += ` \n👍${c.agreenum ?? "0"}`;
        if (c.commentMark) header += ` ⭐️${c.commentMark}`;
        
        output += "\n"+header + time+ "\n";

(function(){
    // 使用正则检测分页标签
    const hasNextLink = /<a\s+rel=\"next\"\s+class=\"next\"[^>]*>下—页<\/a>/i.test(result);
    if (!hasNextLink) return '';
    
    try {
        // 动态生成分页URL（适配数字型URL）
        let url = baseUrl;
        const pageMatch = url.match(/(\d+)(?:_(\d+))?\.html$/);
        if (!pageMatch) return '';
        
        const [_, baseId, currentPage] = pageMatch;
        const pageNum = currentPage ? parseInt(currentPage) : 1;
        
        // 安全限制（最大3页）
        if (pageNum > 2) return ''; // 第3页后停止
        
        // 生成新URL（如 /123_2.html → /123_3.html）
        return url.replace(/(\d+)(?:_(\d+))?\.html$/, `${baseId}_${pageNum + 1}.html`);
    } catch(e) {
        return '';
    }
})()
</js>

time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

ruleContent.content:
<js>
jm=java.base64Decode(java.getString('[name="client"]@content'));
if(jm.length()>1){
var conts = [],list=[];
code=result.match(/codeurl="(\d+)";/)[1];
data=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
datas=data.select("p[style*='text-indent']");
jm=String(jm).split(/[A-Z]+%/);
for(i=0;i<jm.length;i++){
	k=Math.ceil((i + 1) % parseInt(code));
	j=Math.ceil(jm[i] - k);
	conts[j]=datas[i];
	}
	for(i in conts){
		c=String(conts[i]).replace(/.*本章尚未读完,请.*一页继续阅读.*/g,'');
		list.push(c);
		list.join("\n");
		}

<js>
var key = java.get('key');
var page = java.get('page');
var cookieHost = java.getCookie("https://masiro.me");

var headers = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/138.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/138.0.0.0",
    "Referer": "https://masiro.me/admin/novels",
    "Connection": "keep-alive",
    "Cookie": cookieHost || "",
    "X-XSRF-TOKEN": getCookieValue(cookieHost, "XSRF-TOKEN")
};
java.put('searchHeaders', headers);

var url = "https://masiro.me/admin/loadMoreNovels?page=" + page + 
		"&keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(key) +
		"&_t=" + Date.now();

var response = java.get(url, headers);
var responseData = JSON.parse(response.body());

if (responseData.code !== 1) {
    java.error("请求失败: " + responseData.msg);
}

var resultList = [];
responseData.novels.forEach(function(novel) {
    var tags = [];
    novel.tags.forEach(function(tag) {
        tags.push(tag.name);
    });

    var translators = [];
    novel.translators.forEach(function(translator) {
        translators.push(translator.name);
    });

    var coverUrl = "https://masiro.me" + novel.cover_img;

    var novelItem = {
        id: novel.id,
        title: novel.title,
        brief: novel.brief,
        author: novel.author,
        cover: coverUrl,
        status: novel.status, // 0=连载中, 1=已完结
        wordCount: novel.words,
        updateTime: novel.updated_at,
        latestChapter: novel.new_up_content,
        tags: tags.join(", "),
        translators: translators.join(", "),
        readCount: novel.read_num,
        collectCount: novel.collect_nums,
        likeCount: novel.thumb_up,
        sourceUrl: novel.original
    };
    
    resultList.push(novelItem);
});

java.log(JSON.stringify(resultList));
result = resultList;
</js>
